in_hebrew.name: וַיִּילֵי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root יָלַח (yālach), which means 'to depart, leave, or go away.' Wiley could be interpreted as 'God's departure' or 'God's exile.'

in_greek.name: Ιλεύς
in_greek.long_meaning: Of uncertain origin, potentially derived from the Greek word ἵλεος (hilos), meaning 'help' or 'aid.' Wiley in Greek might mean 'helpful' or 'aid.'

in_latin.name: Wilelmus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Old High German 'Wil' meaning 'will' and 'helm' meaning 'helmer' or 'helper.'
